description: Test reports written for the real repair records in data/seed/incidents_seed.json (FDA device reports on steam sterilizers, with the service technician's findings). 'cases' should find a past repair: 'expected' lists every record that describes the same underlying problem. 'low_keyword' marks reports written to share almost no words with the matching records. 'negatives' have no true match; 'look-alike' ones share equipment or wording with a record ('looks_like') but are a different problem. Showing any match for a negative is a false alarm.

cases.query: Steam is leaking around the autoclave door during the sterilization cycle.
Water dripping from the door gasket of the steriliser onto the floor.
Hot vapour escaping where the chamber closes; it's the rubber ring around the hatch.
The big steam cooker for instruments drips all round its front lid.
Autoclave shows a door unsealed alarm and the steam generator is not heating.
Steam generator flooding with water, sight glass full, leak at the heater flange.
Door seal will not retract after the cycle; alarm says too long to unseal.
Bowie-Dick test failed on the autoclave this morning.
The morning check sheet did not change colour evenly in the steam cooker.
Biological indicator came out positive after a sterilizer load.
Water not draining from the autoclave chamber and it alarms too long to exhaust.
After the run, hot water sits at the bottom of the steam cooker and it will not vent.
Autoclave door very stiff to open and close; the handwheel is hard to turn.
Steam leaking from a valve on the sterilizer's steam manifold, puddle under the unit.

Autoclave vacuum pump tripping on overload during pre-vacuum.
Sterilizer room exhaust fan not running, room is hot.
